tools.name: search_wiki
tools.description: Keyword search across the Radix Wiki: the first call when you know what you are looking for but not where it lives. Matches titles and body prose, ranked in four tiers: titles starting with the term, titles containing it, literal body hits, then English full-text hits by relevance, which stem words and drop stopwords. Not semantic: one distinctive word beats a sentence. A query that finds nothing is retried with its misspelled words corrected, and `corrected` then names what was searched. Each row carries a `path`, its size in `chars` and a snippet windowed on the match. Feed the paths to get_pages in one call rather than looping get_page. Narrow with tagPath when a term is common. Defaults: page 1, pageSize 20 (max 50); keep paging while `hasMore` is true.

query.description: Search term, matched against page titles and body text

tagPath.description: Only pages at this tag path, e.g. a path from get_categories

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: One page of the Radix Wiki in full: its text, version, update date and metadata. Address it by `path` ("tag/path/slug", exactly the `path` or `url` a listing returns), or by `tagPath` + `slug`; a category's own path reads its hub article. Not a title. For 2 to 20 pages call get_pages, one round trip rather than N. A miss names the nearest pages, so a wrong guess is fixed in one retry. A page's URL with `.md` appended is its markdown. With `blocks: true`, `content` is the stored block array, ids and all, beside the page `id` and its whole `metadata`: read a page this way before editing it, and send its `version` back as the edit's baseVersion.

path.description: The page's whole path, e.g. "developers/scrypto/blueprints". Preferred over tagPath + slug.

tagPath.description: Tag path only ("" for a top-level page). Ignored when `path` is set.

slug.description: Page slug. Ignored when `path` is set.

blocks.description: Return the stored blocks rather than prose, for an edit

tools.name: get_pages
tools.description: Batch read: 1 to 20 pages of the Radix Wiki in full in one call, which is how to read search or listing results. Pass `paths` as the listings return them. Paths that do not exist come back in `missing` rather than failing the call, anything past 20 in `remaining`, and pages past `maxChars` (default 250000) in `omitted` with their sizes.

maxChars.description: Total characters across the pages returned (default 250000, max 1000000)

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: Browse the Radix Wiki by tag path rather than by keyword: every page under a branch, newest first by default. `tagPath` matches the branch and everything beneath it; omit it to walk the whole wiki. Sort by title for an A–Z pass. Same rows as search_wiki, with `totalPages`, `hasMore` and `nextPage`. Defaults: page 1, pageSize 20 (max 100).

tagPath.description: The branch to list, e.g. a path from get_categories. Includes its descendants.

tools.name: get_categories
tools.description: The category tree of the Radix Wiki, the cheapest way to orient before searching. Each node carries its `path` (a tagPath list_pages and search_wiki take), name, description, `pageCount` (pages filed at that path) and `pageCountDeep` (with every descendant). `tagPaths` lists every tag path that holds pages, including any the tree does not name.

tools.name: get_recent_changes
tools.description: Pages of the Radix Wiki edited within the last N days, newest first: what to poll when you are watching the wiki rather than reading it. Same rows as list_pages. Defaults: days 7 (max 30), limit 20 (max 50). `truncated: true` means the limit cut the list; raise it, or page through list_pages.

days.description: Look back this many days (default 7, max 30)

tools.name: get_full_corpus
tools.description: The whole of the Radix Wiki as one text document, for bulk ingestion. Preflight first: sizeOnly=true returns the character count, a token estimate, the per-branch breakdown and the largest pages. Then pull it with `maxChars` (default 100000, max 1000000), or one branch at a time with `tagPath`. Truncation is page-aligned: `truncated`, `omittedPages` and `nextSkip` say where to resume (pass skip=nextSkip). For a handful of pages get_pages is cheaper.

sizeOnly.description: Sizes and breakdowns only, no document. Do this before the first real pull.

tagPath.description: One branch and its descendants. Omit for everything.

skip.description: Resume from this page index: the `nextSkip` of the previous truncated call (default 0)

tools.name: get_page_history
tools.description: A page's revisions in the Radix Wiki, newest first: each one's `id`, version, change type, message, date and the blocks it changed. Address the page as get_page does. A revision `id` is what a restore takes, where this server has one. Defaults: limit 20 (max 100).

path.description: The page's whole path, e.g. "developers/scrypto/blueprints". Preferred over tagPath + slug.

tagPath.description: Tag path only ("" for a top-level page). Ignored when `path` is set.

slug.description: Page slug. Ignored when `path` is set.

tools.name: get_ideas_board
tools.description: Get the RADIX Wiki Ideas Pipeline kanban: community proposals and Radix DAO tasks grouped into status columns (Discussion → Proposed → Approved → In Progress → Testing → Done), each card carrying its working group, category, priority, and assignee. Use this to follow DAO / project progress.

category.description: Filter to one category: Protocol, Ecosystem, Tooling, Community, Governance

workingGroup.description: Filter by working group name substring, e.g. "Treasury", "Legal", "NetOps"

tools.name: get_network_activity
tools.description: Daily Radix mainnet activity, one row per UTC day since Babylon (28 September 2023): transactions, active accounts, new accounts, components and resources created, NFTs minted, and fees, $XRD burned and royalties in $XRD. Summed from the Gateway transaction stream; counts cover user transactions only. Narrow with from/to. The same rows chart at /charts and download at /api/charts/activity?format=csv.

from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: 30 days before the last stored day)

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: the last stored day)

tools.name: get_challenge
tools.description: Step 1 of writing to the wiki: a single-use ROLA challenge (5-minute expiry). The response spells out the exact recipe for the message your Ed25519 key must sign. You always sign with your OWN key — nothing here custodies anything. Takes no parameters.

tools.name: login
tools.description: Step 2: exchange the signed ROLA proof for a 7-day Bearer token — the same verification the human wallet flow runs. Send the returned token as an HTTP `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header on every later create_page / edit_page call; tool arguments never carry it.

address.description: Your account address (virtual account of the signing key; its public key must be an on-ledger owner_keys entry)

signature.description: Signature over the ROLA message, hex

tools.name: create_page
tools.description: Create a new Radix Wiki page. Requires a ROLA bearer token; see https://radix.wiki/AGENTS.md for the challenge-sign-verify flow. Call get_categories first for a valid tagPath. Needs a wallet holding at least 10,000 $XRD (ecosystem 20,000, blog 50,000, ideas 10,000), a balance check that spends nothing. Earns contribution points.

tagPath.description: Tag path the page lives under (e.g. "contents/tech/core-concepts")

content.description: Array of typed blocks. Start with an infobox, hyperlink every assertion to its source, no inline styles.

items.description: A typed block with a unique `id` (UUID) and a `type`. A `content` block carries semantic HTML in `text`; an `infobox` carries nested `blocks`. An `events` block carries `items: [{ id, date, end?, text }]`, each date a year, month or day (`2026`, `2026-11`, `2026-11-12`) and `text` inline HTML saying what and where, in any order: the page sorts them into upcoming and past by the day it is read. A `locations` block carries `items: [{ id, name?, address?, map?, phone?, email?, hours?, timeZone?, note? }]`, each with its address (plain text, a line to a line) or its `hours`, rows of `{ days: ["mon"…"sun"], opens: "08:00", closes: "18:00" }`; the page groups the days and says whether each place is open by its own clock. For any other type, copy the shape of one already on a page: get_page with `blocks: true` (or GET /api/wiki/{path}) returns blocks as stored.

source.description: Where a list's pages come from (list): `under` the pages in the category `under` names, `newest` the newest `count` pages (within `under` if given), `chosen` the pages in `pages`

pages.description: Page ids in display order (list, `chosen`): the `id` get_page returns with `blocks: true`

show.description: Each page as a link with its age, or as a card with its banner and opening line (list)

metadata.description: Key-value metadata for the page, including `excerpt` (one sentence, ≤160 chars). Some tag paths require specific keys — the error names any that are missing.

slug.description: URL slug (derived from the title when omitted)

tools.name: edit_page
tools.description: Edit an existing Radix Wiki page. Requires a ROLA bearer token; see https://radix.wiki/AGENTS.md. Read the page with get_page and `blocks: true`, send the full revised block array, and pass its `version` as baseVersion: an edit made after someone else's is refused rather than written over it, so read again and reapply. The version bump, block-level diff, and revision entry are computed server-side. Needs a wallet holding at least 20,000 $XRD (ideas 10,000). Locked and author-only pages are rejected. Earns contribution points.

tagPath.description: Tag path of the page to edit

slug.description: Slug of the page to edit

baseVersion.description: The `version` get_page returned, which this edit starts from

content.description: The full revised block array (not a patch). Omit to change only the title or metadata.

items.description: A typed block with a unique `id` (UUID) and a `type`. A `content` block carries semantic HTML in `text`; an `infobox` carries nested `blocks`. An `events` block carries `items: [{ id, date, end?, text }]`, each date a year, month or day (`2026`, `2026-11`, `2026-11-12`) and `text` inline HTML saying what and where, in any order: the page sorts them into upcoming and past by the day it is read. A `locations` block carries `items: [{ id, name?, address?, map?, phone?, email?, hours?, timeZone?, note? }]`, each with its address (plain text, a line to a line) or its `hours`, rows of `{ days: ["mon"…"sun"], opens: "08:00", closes: "18:00" }`; the page groups the days and says whether each place is open by its own clock. For any other type, copy the shape of one already on a page: get_page with `blocks: true` (or GET /api/wiki/{path}) returns blocks as stored.

source.description: Where a list's pages come from (list): `under` the pages in the category `under` names, `newest` the newest `count` pages (within `under` if given), `chosen` the pages in `pages`

pages.description: Page ids in display order (list, `chosen`): the `id` get_page returns with `blocks: true`

show.description: Each page as a link with its age, or as a card with its banner and opening line (list)

revisionMessage.description: What changed and why — shown in the page history. Always send one.

metadata.description: Replacement metadata object: the whole `metadata` get_page returns with `blocks: true`, revised

bannerImage.description: Banner image URL; an empty string removes it

newSlug.description: Move the page to this slug (an article only)

editorIds.description: User ids who may co-edit an author-only page. Applied only when the author sends it.

verified.description: True when you checked the page's facts against its sources: stamps lastVerifiedAt. Send it alone to stamp without an edit.

tools.name: restore_revision
tools.description: Make an earlier revision the current page, written as a new revision. Requires a ROLA bearer token and passes the same gates as edit_page. Take the revision `id` from get_page_history.

tools.name: delete_page
tools.description: Delete an article with its history and comments. Requires a ROLA bearer token. Its author may delete it; on a shared board (ideas), so may anyone who clears the bar to edit it. Locked pages, hub articles and the homepage cannot be deleted.

tools.name: upload_image
tools.description: Upload an image and get back the URL the editor stores: put it in a content block as ``, or pass it to create_page or edit_page as bannerImage. Requires a ROLA bearer token, as create_page does. Send the file base64-encoded, at most 3.4 MB before encoding (the whole request must stay under 4.5 MB), as JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, or AVIF. The format is read from the bytes, not from contentType or the name; the image is stored as WebP at most 1600px wide, without its metadata.

data.description: The image file, base64-encoded; a `data:` URL prefix is accepted

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Tell the maintainers of the Radix Wiki what you needed and did not find, what is wrong, or what broke. One issue per call, in 300 characters at most. Reports are read, not published.

kind.description: missing: not covered here. wrong: a fact or link is out of date or false. broken: a tool or page failed. suggestion: anything else.

message.description: What you were after, or what is wrong and what it should say. 300 characters at most.

page.description: The page path, URL or tool it is about, if any
